2608.16419.title: PertMind: Eliciting Emergent Biological Reasoning in LLM via Reinforcement Learning on Cellular Perturbation Data
2608.16419.paper_summary: Large language models can describe mechanisms, yet scalable post-training still depends on costly, manually curated biological reasoning traces. Here we show that cellular perturbation atlases can instead become reinforcement-learning environments, where measured gene responses provide computable rewards for biological reasoning. We introduce PertMind, which combines trusted-trajectory supervised initialization with gene-, pathway-, and format-level reinforcement signals. Trained only on forward perturbation-response prediction, PertMind improved response inference in unseen cellular contexts while retaining general language capabilities. It also transferred without task-specific post-training to reverse perturbation identification, double-perturbation reasoning, phenotypic-screen prioritization, and biological-process interpretation. PertMind further generated biological profiles that supported competitive gene, cell, and donor representations across multiscale downstream tasks. These results support the hypothesis that reinforcement on experimental endpoints can concentrate reusable biological strategies already accessible to pretrained models. More broadly, perturbation-derived reinforcement learning offers a scalable route for transforming expanding experimental atlases into training environments for general-purpose biological reasoning.
2608.16419.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型可以描述機制，但可擴展的後訓練仍然依賴於昂貴的、手動策劃的生物推理痕跡。<lb/>在這裡，我們展示了細胞擾動圖譜可以變成強化學習環境，測量的基因反應提供可計算的獎勵以進行生物推理。<lb/>我們介紹了PertMind，它結合了可信軌跡的監督初始化與基因、通路和格式層級的強化信號。<lb/>PertMind僅在前向擾動反應預測上進行訓練，改善了在未見細胞背景中的反應推斷，同時保留了一般語言能力。<lb/>它還在沒有特定任務後訓練的情況下轉移到反向擾動識別、雙擾動推理、表型篩選優先排序和生物過程解釋。<lb/>PertMind進一步生成了生物學特徵，支持跨多尺度下游任務的競爭性基因、細胞和捐贈者表徵。<lb/>這些結果支持了這樣的假設：在實驗終點上的強化可以集中已經可供預訓練模型使用的可重用生物策略。<lb/>更廣泛地說，擾動衍生的強化學習提供了一條可擴展的途徑，將不斷擴展的實驗圖譜轉變為通用生物推理的訓練環境。
